_comment: Machine-readable ledger of external evidence about WasmAgent artifacts. Distinct evidence_type values carry distinct claim ceilings; formal_certification is never inferred from organization affiliation and requires explicit certificate fields. Consumed by scripts/validate-external-evidence.py (EXT-01..07).

records.subject: AEP
records.claim_ceiling: Independent layered run reproduced the stated JS/Rust and semantic corpus behavior for the pinned component tuple. The merged record is external evidence, not formal certification.
limitations: This is not an end-to-end certification.

records.subject: AEP / MCP08
records.claim_ceiling: WasmAgent contributors are participating in public OWASP MCP Top 10 control-language and implementation-reference discussions.
limitations: An open issue/PR in an OWASP project is a public contribution under discussion, not testing, certification, or endorsement.
OWASP issue #44 is a reference-implementation proposal (VAL); WasmAgent artifacts are referenced as prior art, not adopted.
